title: Burst prompt line
description: The line live-inbox <seat> --prompt posts to /activity. Same fields as activity.schema.json with kind prompt. room is optional, prompt only, at most 40 characters. A pulse is action sent: the seat stays working for 10 minutes. No prompt body, no message text. An old collector still reads fleet/prompts.jsonl (env BURST_PROMPTS). Seats do not write that file. The collector also reads legacy {t_ct, from, to} lines; see $defs.legacyPrompt.

seat.description: Seat id or a display name. Display names resolve through seats config aliases.

from.description: prompt only: who sent it. from blaze credits Blaze. Never the text.

room.description: prompt only: a short room name, at most 40 characters.

legacyPrompt.description: Legacy prompt line. Read only: the collector maps `to` to the seat and treats the line as a SENT pulse. New lines use the top-level shape. POST /activity does not take this shape.

to.description: Seat that got the prompt. Seat id or display name resolved through aliases.
